summary: Iter 87 — Prenotazione Demo + Brevo lista Lead (ID 8) + funnel gating. Backend 11/11 pytest passing: privacy required (400), demo_slot/demo_status 'da_confermare' persisted, brevo_sync.status='non_configurato' (preview, BREVO_API_KEY empty) with attempts incrementing, marketing_consent/marketing_consent_at valorizzati, idempotent re-POST same email, invalid demo_data/demo_ora → 400, SA demo confirm/reschedule/cancel transitions + 400 on confirm w/o slot + 400 on reschedule w/o date, QA admin → 403 on SA endpoints, lead_brevo_sync increments attempts, demo_booking.tick retries errored sync (attempts 1→2 after 2h cutoff) and sets demo_reminder_sent_for exactly once per slot, cron endpoint requires WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET bearer. UI: LandingPage form at 390px shows all fields (nome/email/demo_data[min=tomorrow]/demo_ora/marketing[not pre-checked]/privacy/submit), submission creates lead with demo_slot='2026-10-10T09:30' + brevo_sync=non_configurato. SA drawer at /marketing/organizzatori?tab=leads opens on row click, DemoBox renders status/confirm/cancel/new-date/new-time/reschedule/brevo-sync/brevo-retry/marketing-consent — confirm→Confermata, reschedule→Riprogrammata verified end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: After rapid sequential actions (reschedule immediately followed by cancel), the second action may not fire — observed drawer still showing 'Riprogrammata' and backend demo_status unchanged to 'annullata'. Likely a state/refresh race: `sel.lead` in parent uses stale state while `act()` is in flight. Each action in isolation works. Low priority.

action_items: (optional, low) In Leads.jsx DemoBox, disable the whole action group while `busy` is true OR await `onDone()` to resolve before enabling subsequent clicks, to avoid stale-state races when the SA chains actions quickly.
critical_code_review_comments: demo_booking.sync_lead always increments attempts even when status becomes 'non_configurato' or 'sincronizzato'. For successful syncs it's probably fine but 'attempts' loses its 'retry counter' meaning. Consider resetting attempts=0 on success for clearer semantics (currently cron retry gate uses $lt:5 so a successful sync eventually blocks retries anyway, but after many manual retries this could prematurely cap the real retry budget).

demo_booking.tick: 'lo' = now_rome formatted and demo_slot is also stored in local-naive 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM' — if the server timezone differs from Europe/Rome at any point, string comparison could misfire for slots near midnight. Already works today because fmt is consistent.

server.py create_lead stores marketing_consent_at = now_iso() (UTC ISO) while brevo attribute 'DATA_CONSENSO_MARKETING' slices [:10] — fine, but if the user is at UTC+2 near 23:00 the date in Brevo may differ from the user's local day. Minor.
server.py lead_demo_action: on 'confirm' path a lead with demo_slot but marketing_consent=False still proceeds — correct (operational), but confirm with no demo_slot returns 400 as expected. OK.

demo_booking.sync_lead sets _attrs_ready at process level; after a backend restart it will re-POST the 6 contactAttributes creates on first sync. Idempotent on Brevo side (409 ignored) but adds latency. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 90% — all testids present, form submission + confirm + reschedule verified; cancel-after-reschedule had a UI state race (not reproducible when done in isolation).
